records.issue_text: Recovery-code validation in BackwardsCompatibilityUserStorage.java:340 accepts codes without atomically consuming them, while getCredentials() reconstructs the complete retained set, allowing successfully used recovery codes to be replayed indefinitely.
records.rationale: The finding correctly identifies that BackwardsCompatibilityUserStorage.isValid() at line 283-305 validates recovery codes by checking if the input matches any code in the stored list (line 305: `return generatedKeys.stream().anyMatch(key -> key.equals(input.getChallengeResponse()))`), but does NOT remove or mark the used code as consumed. This means the same code can be validated multiple times. However, this is a TEST provider (in testsuite-providers), not production code.
